neighbours.label: Excess/insufficiency degree: ' to' after 'too ADJ' (too heavy to, too little to) and 'not quite X' contrasts
fire: The box was too heavy to carry up the stairs.
He earns too little to rent an apartment downtown.
The water was far too cold to swim in.
The gap is too narrow to fit a finger through.
She was too tired to finish the report.
The print is too small to read without glasses.
It was not quite a song, but not quite a poem either.
The fish are too large to have come from the pond.
quiet: The box was heavy, so we carried it up the stairs slowly.
He earns enough money and rents an apartment downtown.
The water was cold but we swam in it anyway.
The gap is narrow and hard to see in the dark.
She was tired but finished the report.
The print is small and the pages are thin.
It was a song, and a rather catchy one.
The fish are large and came from the pond.

notes: Card: 'too little to', 'too large to', 'not-quite', 'not quite predators,'. The + pole is dense.
